headline: Six appointments to the new Historical Commission, plus a Recycling Advisory Committee appointment.
summary: Six people named by Mayor Joshua Garcia would serve on the new Historical Commission. The agenda also lists a Recycling Advisory Committee appointment and a resolution on increased transparency in board communication with citizens.
items: Appoint Susan Brouillette of 179 Morgan St. to the Historical Commission; term expires December 1, 2026.
Appoint Stephan Fay of 218 Pleasant St. to the Historical Commission; term expires July 1, 2029.
Appoint Amelia Mosley of 140 Lincoln St. to the Historical Commission; term expires May 1, 2027.
Appoint Kate Hopkinson of 87 Pearl St. to the Historical Commission; term expires July 1, 2029.
Appoint Kevin Rice of 52 Fairfield Ave. to the Historical Commission; term expires April 16, 2027.
Appoint Fleur Kuhta of 124 Chestnut St. to the Historical Commission; term expires October 1, 2027.
Recycling Advisory Committee appointments, three-year terms expiring August 2028; Cynthia Koch is the only new appointment to be interviewed. Tabled January 15, 2026.
Order by Devine that the City Council adopt a resolution on increased transparency in board communication with citizens; on the administratively tabled list.
location: Holyoke City Hall, 536 Dwight St, with Zoom access
plain_text:
Published October 2, 2026, 1:33 p.m.
City Council
Holyoke Massachusetts
Pursuant to the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25,
Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025,
notice is hereby given of a meeting of the committee on
Public Service
Wednesday, October 7, 2026
6:30 PM
Meeting to take place at
Holyoke City Hall, 536 Dwight St
and can be accessed remotely on Zoom Meetings
Per order of the Chair: Juan Anderson-Burgos
Remote access via www.zoom.us
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86708491183?pwd=Ef9q9ibN3aaOF7uwkJHmT4uCwvyqbv.1
Meeting ID: 867 0849 1183 Meeting Passcode: 256634 or by call in at 1 (646) 558-8656 with
the same Meeting ID and Passcode.
Live Spanish interpretation will be available on local access channel 15 using the television's
SAP option, through the live stream on the city website, as well as on the Zoom feed by clicking
the interpretation option and choosing Spanish.
Agenda
Item 1: Minutes of June 24, 2026 meeting.
Item 2: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Ms. Susan Brouillette of 179
Morgan St. to serve on the new Historical Commission. Term will expire on December 1, 2026.
Item 3: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Mr. Stephan Fay of 218 Pleasant
St. to serve on the new Historical Commission. Term will expire on July 1, 2029.
Item 4: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Ms. Amelia Mosley of 140 Lincoln
St. to serve on the new Historical Commission Term will expire May 1, 2027.
Item 5: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Ms. Kate Hopkinson of 87 Pearl
St. to serve on the new Historical Commission. Term will expire July 1, 2029.
Item 6: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Mr. Kevin Rice of 52 Fairfield Ave.
to serve on the new Historical Commission. Term will expire April 16, 2027.
Item 7: 9-15-26 From Mayor Joshua Garcia-letter appointing Ms. Fleur Kuhta of 124 Chestnut
St. to serve on the new Historical Commission. Term will expire October 1, 2027.
LAID ON THE TABLE
(Items taken up at previous meeting(s) and laid on the table. Discussion may or may not take
place)
Item 8: 6-3-25 From Mayor Joshua Garcia, letter appointing several members to serve on the
Recycling Advisory Committee. Members will serve a three-year term expiring August 2028.
*Clarification: Cynthia Koch is the only new appointment to be interviewed.
*Tabled 1-15-26
ADMINISTRATIVELY LAID ON THE TABLE
(Per City Council Rule 9P, "Any order not acted on within 45 days shall be deemed tabled."
Items within this section are laid on the table by virtue of being in the committee more than 45
days. Discussion of these items is unlikely, but any item may be removed from the table upon
motion of the committee.)
Item 9: 12-16-25 Devine-Ordered that the City Council adopt the attached resolution regarding
Increased Transparency in Board Communication with Citizens.
Administrative Assistant: Jeffery Anderson-Burgos
The listing of matters are those reasonably anticipated by the chair which may be discussed at
the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items may also be brought
up for discussion to the extent permitted by law. Agenda subject to change up to two business
days (48 hours) prior to posted meeting time.
